extra.final_summary: Found and fixed several data quality issues: (1) body_mass_g was text with comma formatting - cast to numeric; (2) 3 rows had out-of-range body mass values (millions instead of thousands) - excluded rows 0, 17, 34; (3) species had misspellings (Adeile, Gentto) - normalized to Adelie, Gentoo; (4) island had case variant (biscoe) - normalized to Biscoe. After fixes, analyzed average body mass by sex: female = 3735.0g, male = 4570.8333g (based on 54 rows).
